title: Parameters

assignment_status.description: The assignment status of the fulfillment orders that should be returned. If assignment_status parameter isn't provided, then the query will return all assigned fulfillment orders, except those with the CLOSED status.
assignment_status.title: Assignment Status

location_ids[].description: The IDs of the assigned locations of the fulfillment orders that should be returned. If not provided, returns all fulfillment orders assigned to the shop locations managed by the app.
location_ids[].title: Location IDs

description: Query parameters to filter assigned fulfillment orders by status or location.
